{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|I still remember the feel of sunlight on my skin. The scent of favorite foods. The color of my first love's eyes.|Lord Scourge|<ref name="Eternal Emptiness">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Lord Scourge|Eternal Emptiness}}</ref>}}
An '''individual''' was the first love of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]].<ref name="Eternal Emptiness" /> After he was subjected to a scientific recreation of an [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] [[Ritual of Nathema|ritual]] by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]],<ref name="What Was Lost">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Lord Scourge|What Was Lost}}</ref> Scourge was stripped of his physical senses, and he grew to treasure the memories of the things he could no longer sense, such as the [[Color/Legends|color]] of his love's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Eternal Emptiness" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
When Scourge allied with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] in order to defeat the Emperor<ref name="An Unthinkable Alliance">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|An Unthinkable Alliance|Sith Emperor's Fortress}}</ref> around [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|3}}</ref> he later mentioned the memory of his love's eyes when trying to make the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] understand how the Emperor had stripped himself and Scourge of their humanity.<ref name="Eternal Emptiness" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
This individual was first mentioned in the optional conversation "Eternal Emptiness" with Lord Scourge, a companion character for the Jedi Knight class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The individual's [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Gender/Legends|gender]], and ultimate fate are not specified.<ref name="Eternal Emptiness" />
